formParseDocsByRegex.title: Extract data from documents
formParseDocsByRegex.invalidConfigMessage: The config has errors — fix them in the settings:
formParseDocsByRegex.noFolderHint: Pick a folder: documents are read without creating any files on disk, and the result appears in the table below.

docRegexResultsTable.intermediateColumnTitle: Intermediate value "{{id}}" — not one of the result columns
docRegexResultsTable.selectionHint: Select cells with the mouse (Shift extends the selection); click a row number or a column header to select the whole row or column. Ctrl+C copies the selection, Ctrl+A selects all. Values that weren't found are highlighted in yellow.

docRegexDocumentViewer.title: Document texts
docRegexDocumentViewer.noTextHint: The document has no text — most likely it's a scan (an image). Text recognition (OCR) isn't supported.

docRegexModalConfigSettings.title: Document data extraction settings
docRegexModalConfigSettings.importErrorAlert: Import failed: invalid file or JSON format
docRegexModalConfigSettings.exportErrorAlert: Export failed: invalid JSON in the editor
docRegexModalConfigSettings.formUnavailableMessage: The form is unavailable while the JSON has a syntax error:

docRegexConfigForm.transformsHint: Steps run one after another on the extracted value.
docRegexConfigForm.flagsTitle: RegExp flags: i — case-insensitive, m — ^ and $ per line, s — dot matches line breaks, u — Unicode
docRegexConfigForm.transformDateHint: Recognises "“28” 10 2026 р.", "28 жовтня 2026", "2026-10-28" and the like, and turns them into 28.10.2026.
docRegexConfigForm.patternHint: The value is capture group 1 — (…), or the whole match when there are no groups.
docRegexConfigForm.patternOptionalHint: When empty, the whole piece is taken.
docRegexConfigForm.templateHint: Builds the value from groups: $1, $2, $<name>; $& is the whole match.
docRegexConfigForm.fileExtensionsHint: Comma-separated. Other files in the folder are ignored.
docRegexConfigForm.qualifierHint: Decides whether a document is of the right type. Documents that fail the check are skipped.
docRegexConfigForm.keywordsHint: One per line. Case and whitespace are ignored — "CONTRACT for" even finds a glued "CONTRACTfor".
docRegexConfigForm.keywordsPlaceholder:
CONTRACT
for the provision of services
docRegexConfigForm.fieldsHint: Values extracted from the document — one after another, top to bottom.
docRegexConfigForm.sourceHint: The document text, or the value of one of the previous fields.
docRegexConfigForm.splitLabel: Split the value into several rows
docRegexConfigForm.splitHint: Every piece becomes its own result row, and the document's other values repeat in each of them. Only one field can be split.
docRegexConfigForm.splitColumnsHint: The regular expressions are applied to each piece separately.
docRegexConfigForm.compoundsHint: Glue other values together by a template. If any of them is empty, the combined value is empty too.
docRegexConfigForm.columnsHint: What ends up in the table and in copies, and in which order. Every other value is intermediate.
